description: How to obtain a business permit from any of the 17 municipal governments in Aklan. Required for all businesses operating within the Province of Aklan.
steps: Step 1 — Get a Barangay Business Clearance from the Barangay Hall where your business is located.
Step 2 — Go to the Business Permit and Licensing Office (BPLO) at your Provincial Capitol, Kalibo, Aklan.
Step 3 — Fill out the Unified Application Form and submit required documents.
Step 4 — Undergo inspections (zoning, sanitary, fire safety) as required.
Step 5 — Pay the business permit fee at the Municipal Treasurer's Office.
Step 6 — Receive your Governor's Permit / Municipal Business Permit.
requirements: Lease Contract or Proof of Property Ownership

quickInfo.appointmentType: Walk-in at Provincial Capitol, Kalibo, Aklan BPLO

sources.name: Local Government Code of the Philippines (RA 7160)

description: Participate in provincial and municipal trade fairs, business expos, and tourism promotion events in Aklan, including the world-famous Ati-Atihan Festival (January, Kalibo).
steps: Check announcements from the Aklan Provincial Tourism Office and EEDD for upcoming trade fairs.
Prepare eligibility documents: DTI/SEC/CDA registration, current business permit, product list.
Submit an Application/Intent Form with your business profile and booth requirements.
Await assessment and confirmation from the organizer.
Pay booth fees (if applicable) and attend the event.

quickInfo.fee: Varies per event (booth fees may apply)
quickInfo.whoCanApply: Registered MSMEs and tourism enterprises in Aklan

description: How to rent market stalls in public markets and economic enterprise facilities managed by the Provincial Government of Aklan, including the Lee Jetty Port and Passenger Terminal.
steps: Inquire at the Economic Enterprise Development Department (EEDD) or your Provincial Capitol, Kalibo, Aklan.
Fill out the market stall rental application form.
Submit proof of identity, residency, and type of goods to be sold.
Await assessment and allocation of available stall.
Pay rental fees and deposits at the EEDD or Municipal Treasurer's Office.
Comply with market sanitation and operation rules.

quickInfo.fee: Varies by stall type and location

sources.name: Lee Jetty Port and Passenger Terminal — (036) 288-7419
